items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Well, I got a lot of ideas, nice ideas from Louis Barbaran and Paul.

ctx.x: Were there any drummers that you ever got ideas from that you'd talk to even if you didn't take regular lessons that you'd go around and ask them anything or try to help you?

Well, I used to, they got, there was two of them I got inspiration from. There's two brothers, Paul Barbaran and Louis Barbaran. Well, those are my inspiration drummers later. They come later. Johnny come later. But they were wonderful drummers and they still are. Both still playing. Well, I got a lot of ideas, nice ideas from Louis Barbaran and Paul. Paul was playing with Louis Armstrong at the time. He came down here at this old Collier Center. Louis had a big band.
